description: Compare a locale file with the keys the code actually references. Reports a key nothing references, which is translated on every release and shown never, and a referenced key the file does not define, which shows the key itself in the interface. A key built at run time cannot be found by any scan, so the caller declares its prefix and those keys are excluded with the exclusion recorded. The reference list is the caller’s, and nothing is scanned here. Pay 160000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

dynamic_key_prefixes.description: Prefixes of keys built at run time. Each excluded key is recorded rather than silently dropped.

messages.description: The locale file. A messages object, or JSON text, at most 2097152 bytes. Nested objects are flattened to separated keys, so a file written either way is read the same. Nothing is fetched: the files are supplied, so an arbitrary project can be audited.

referenced_keys.description: The keys the code references. Only the caller knows how their code names keys, so this is supplied rather than derived.

name: locale_key_usage_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

fully_used.description: True only when every defined key was referenced, every reference resolved, and nothing was excluded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.
